headline: Juniper Green Energy reports Q2 FY27 profit of ₹53.56 crore
hook: Renewable energy firm swings to profit
summary: Juniper Green Energy reported a profit after tax of ₹53.56 crore for the second quarter of FY27. The company's EBITDA saw a significant increase, rising 162% compared to the previous period. This performance marks a turnaround for the renewable energy player. The results reflect operational scaling within the company's green energy portfolio.
why_it_matters: Signals improving operational efficiency in the renewable energy sector.

headline: Juniper Green Energy reports Q2 revenue and EBITDA growth
hook: Profit margins expand despite quarterly net dip
summary: Juniper Green Energy reported a 19% increase in revenue and a 20% rise in EBITDA to ₹313 crore for the second quarter. EBITDA margins improved to 90.7% from 89.6% in the previous quarter. Despite operational growth, the company's net profit declined by 8% on a quarter-on-quarter basis. The results reflect strong operational efficiency alongside a slight contraction in bottom-line profitability.
why_it_matters: Operational efficiency gains offset by quarterly profit decline.
